*   **Time Complexity:** $O(N \cdot B)$, where $N$ is the number of samples per ray and $B$ is the number of rays.
Chunking does not change the asymptotic complexity but increases overhead due to loop iterations.
The technique is essential for real-time inference of large neural radiance fields and volumetric datasets.
